title: Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide Europe's largest asset manager raised its Strategy holding to 1.9 million shares in the third quarter, a 13F shows, even as MSTR has since fallen about 18% from quarter-end. This post Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot
summary: Bitcoin Magazine North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot Elliptic says North Korean launderers created six throwaway meme tokens on NEAR between Nov. 5 and 7, moving about $430,000 of stolen Binance funds through homemade liquidity pools. title: TD Cowen Gives Stablecoin Yield Ban 10% Odds as Banks Plan Push in Democrat-Led Congress
summary: Bitcoin Magazine TD Cowen Gives Stablecoin Yield Ban 10% Odds as Banks Plan Push in Democrat-Led Congress TD Cowen's Jaret Seiberg puts only a 10% chance on a congressional ban on platform stablecoin yield over the next two years, even as banks renew their push after Democratic midterm wins. title: BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT
summary: Bitcoin Magazine BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT BlackRock's Robbie Mitchnick told Barron's demand to swap directly held bitcoin for IBIT shares is at its highest yet, with "security and peace of mind" the top reason as kidnappings and hacks rise. title: Binance to Close Accounts in Four EU Countries Dec. 31, Charging Idle Balances From Nov. 29
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Binance to Close Accounts in Four EU Countries Dec. 31, Charging Idle Balances From Nov. 29 Binance told users in France, Spain, Italy and Poland to withdraw their crypto, with deposits blocked, accounts closing Dec. 31 and a monthly fee starting Nov. 29, as the exchange still lacks an EU license. title: U.S. Regulators Drop $250 Travel Rule Plan, Crypto Language Too
summary: Bitcoin Magazine U.S. Regulators Drop $250 Travel Rule Plan, Crypto Language Too FinCEN and the Federal Reserve formally withdrew a 2020 proposal that would have cut the cross-border funds-transfer threshold from $3,000 to $250 and spelled out that the rules cover crypto, saying any future version needs a fresh comment period. This post U.S. Regulators Drop $250 Travel Rule Plan, Crypto Language Too first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Coinbase Wins Full Federal Trust Charter From OCC
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase Wins Full Federal Trust Charter From OCC Coinbase's custody arm has completed its national trust bank charter with the OCC, upgrading April's conditional approval, but the license does not let it take deposits, make loans or issue stablecoins. This post Coinbase Wins Full Federal Trust Charter From OCC first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
